title: Montreal man convicted of killing 9-year-old daughter to be sentenced today
summary: A U.S. judge is expected to hand down a sentence Wednesday for Luciano Frattolin, a Montreal man who was found guilty in August of the second-degree murder of his nine-year-old daughter, Melina.

image.caption: Luciano Frattolin is taken away from the Essex County Courthouse in Elizabethtown, N.Y., on Thursday, July 23, 2026. (Christopher Katsarov/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: A U.S. judge is expected to hand down a sentence Wednesday for Luciano Frattolin, a Montreal man who was found guilty in August of the second-degree murder of his nine-year-old daughter, Melina.
Luciano Frattolin faces life in prison for 2nd-degree murder charge
The jury also convicted Frattolin of concealment of a human corpse.
The minimum sentence for the second-degree murder charge alone is 15 years to life, while the maximum is life imprisonment.
Frattolin and Melina were wrapping up a weeklong trip in the United States when the former reported her missing on July 19, 2025.

items: N.Y. jury convicts Montreal father of murder in death of 9-year-old daughter

blocks.text: Her body was found the next day in a marsh near Ticonderoga, N.Y., about 400 kilometres north of New York City. The autopsy found she died from asphyxia due to drowning.
Frattolin initially reported that two men had kidnapped Melina, but he was arrested shortly after for her murder.
He was held without bail for just under a year until his trial, which unfolded over three weeks in the summer at the Essex County Courthouse in Elizabethtown, N.Y.
With files from The Canadian Press
